newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Asian Metals - Korea market seen dull before holiday.
newsitem.headline: Asian Metals - Korea market seen dull before holiday.

text.p: South Korea's domestic metal market was quiet ahead of a long holiday with demand depressed by a series of economic woes, traders in Seoul said on Wednesday.
The South Korean metal market will be closed on Thursday for Labour Day and next Monday for Children's Day.
"We expect nothing on the domestic market for the rest of this week and early next week due to the long holiday," a trader with Tong Yang Global Corp said.
South Korea's metal industry has been battered by the collapse of Hanbo Steel Co in January and Sammi Steel Co in March and the Jinro Group's recent financial troubles.

But the Tong Yang trader said the domestic market showed some supply tightness for copper in line with the tight world market. He said tight domestic lead supplies stemmed from recent declining shipments from China.
"Due to recent price falls in the world lead market, China seems to have cut its lead exports as there was no profit opportunity," the trader said.
